北京.name: 北京
北京.ai_briefing_zh: 北京多云，体感微凉，记得添衣别着凉哦！
北京.ai_briefing_en: Beijing is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to add clothes to stay warm!

慈溪.name: 慈溪
慈溪.ai_briefing_zh: 慈溪阴天，体感凉意浓，出门记得保暖哦！
慈溪.ai_briefing_en: Cixi is overcast and feels chilly. Remember to keep warm when you go out!

上海.name: 上海
上海.ai_briefing_zh: 上海阴天，气温适宜，小心昼夜温差，早晚添衣哦。
上海.ai_briefing_en: Shanghai is overcast, temperatures are pleasant. Watch for day-night differences, add clothes in mornings/evenings.

广州.name: 广州
广州.ai_briefing_zh: 广州阴天，体感湿热，注意防暑补水，保持清爽！
广州.ai_briefing_en: Guangzhou is overcast and feels muggy. Stay hydrated, keep cool and fresh!

深圳.name: 深圳
深圳.ai_briefing_zh: 深圳阴天，湿度较大，记得补水，保持好心情！
深圳.ai_briefing_en: Shenzhen is overcast with high humidity. Remember to hydrate and keep a good mood!

杭州.name: 杭州
杭州.ai_briefing_zh: 杭州小雨，体感湿冷，记得带伞，注意保暖哦！
杭州.ai_briefing_en: Hangzhou has light rain and feels damp and cold. Remember your umbrella and keep warm!

南京.name: 南京
南京.ai_briefing_zh: 南京有雾，能见度低，驾车出行请注意安全！
南京.ai_briefing_en: Nanjing is foggy with low visibility. Please drive safely when traveling!

成都.name: 成都
成都.ai_briefing_zh: 成都多云，天气舒适，正是出游的好时节哦！
成都.ai_briefing_en: Chengdu is cloudy with comfortable weather, a great time for outings!

武汉.name: 武汉
武汉.ai_briefing_zh: 武汉阴天，体感偏凉，记得适时添衣，注意防寒。
武汉.ai_briefing_en: Wuhan is overcast and feels cool. Remember to add clothes as needed and stay warm.

西安.name: 西安
西安.ai_briefing_zh: 西安晴朗，体感微凉，阳光正好，注意补水哦！
西安.ai_briefing_en: Xi'an is sunny and feels a bit cool. It's a lovely day, remember to hydrate!

重庆.name: 重庆
重庆.ai_briefing_zh: 重庆阴天，风力稍大，体感偏凉，记得防风保暖。
重庆.ai_briefing_en: Chongqing is overcast with some wind. It feels cool, remember to stay warm and protected from the wind.

哈尔滨.name: 哈尔滨
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_zh: 哈尔滨晴朗，气温较低，体感寒冷，务必多穿衣物！
哈尔滨.ai_briefing_en: Harbin is sunny but quite cold, feeling frigid. Make sure to bundle up warmly!

沈阳.name: 沈阳
沈阳.ai_briefing_zh: 沈阳多云，体感偏冷，注意保暖，出门别忘防风哦。
沈阳.ai_briefing_en: Shenyang is cloudy and feels cold. Stay warm, and remember to protect yourself from the wind when going out.

昆明.name: 昆明
昆明.ai_briefing_zh: 昆明多云，体感舒适，风力稍大，出行注意防风。
昆明.ai_briefing_en: Kunming is cloudy and feels comfortable. It's a bit windy, so be mindful of the wind when out.

厦门.name: 厦门
厦门.ai_briefing_zh: 厦门多云，气温适宜，出门游玩记得防晒补水哦！
厦门.ai_briefing_en: Xiamen is cloudy with pleasant temperatures. If you're out, remember sun protection and hydration!

青岛.name: 青岛
青岛.ai_briefing_zh: 青岛多云，体感微凉，记得添衣，小心着凉哦。
青岛.ai_briefing_en: Qingdao is cloudy and feels a bit cool. Remember to add clothes to avoid catching a cold.

大连.name: 大连
大连.ai_briefing_zh: 大连多云，风力大，体感寒冷，务必多穿防风衣物！
大连.ai_briefing_en: Dalian is cloudy, windy, and feels very cold. Be sure to wear warm, windproof clothing!
